simple.meaning: עֲלַע (ʻălaʻ) is a Hebrew word meaning “a rib.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H5967. ala [ עֲלַע ] noun feminine rib ( ᵑ7 Syriac; see Biblical Hebrew I. צֵלָע צלע, ); — plural absolute עִלְעִין Dan 7:5 . [ עֲלָת ] see עלה . above

occurrences.englishText: “Behold, there was another animal, a second, like a bear. It was raised up on one side, and three ribs were in its mouth between its teeth. They said this to it: ‘Arise! Devour much flesh!’
